scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model definition, assumptions on infectivity and infection-rate functions, the untreated threshold, uniform immunization, targeted immunization, the covariance argument, Theorem 4.2, and the numerical comparison. The closely related Fu--Small--Walker--Zhang full text was inspected at its piecewise-linear infectivity and targeted-versus-proportional covariance argument. Exact rational arithmetic replays the counterexample and threshold identities. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result isolates the equal-budget uniform-versus-degree-targeted comparison. The explicit two-degree example is mathematically admissible but not empirically calibrated, and the result does not assert that the source's numerical parameter choices have negative covariance or that high-degree targeting is generally inferior.

title: A covariance obstruction to high-degree immunization in a heterogeneous network SIS model
